name: ESP32 Development Board (WiFi + Bluetooth)
description: ESP32-WROOM-32 development board with built-in WiFi and Bluetooth. Dual-core 240MHz processor, 520KB SRAM, 34 GPIO pins. Perfect for IoT projects, robotics, and embedded systems coursework.

name: Arduino Uno R3 (ATmega328P)
description: Official Arduino Uno R3 board based on ATmega328P microcontroller. 14 digital I/O pins, 6 analog inputs, 16MHz clock. The go-to board for beginners and engineering lab projects.

name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B (4GB RAM)
description: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B with 4GB LPDDR4 RAM, quad-core Cortex-A72 CPU, dual micro-HDMI, USB 3.0, Gigabit Ethernet. Ideal for mini-servers, AI/ML projects, and Linux labs.

name: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Distance Sensor
description: Ultrasonic ranging module HC-SR04 provides 2cm-400cm non-contact measurement. Working voltage 5V, trigger input signal 10µs TTL pulse. Essential for robotics and obstacle avoidance projects.

name: DHT11 Temperature & Humidity Sensor
description: Digital temperature and humidity sensor with calibrated digital signal output. Measures 20-90% RH humidity and 0-50°C temperature. Great for weather stations and IoT monitoring.

name: MQ-2 Gas & Smoke Sensor Module
description: MQ-2 gas sensor module detects LPG, propane, methane, alcohol, hydrogen, and smoke. Analog and digital output. Widely used in gas leakage detection and air quality monitoring projects.

name: IR Obstacle Avoidance Sensor Module
description: Infrared obstacle avoidance sensor module with adjustable detection distance (2-30cm). Digital output, 3.3V-5V compatible. Perfect for line-following robots and proximity detection.

name: Solderless Breadboard 830 Points
description: Full-size 830-point solderless breadboard with 2 power rails and 63 rows. ABS plastic body with nickel-plated phosphor bronze contacts. Essential prototyping tool for every electronics student.

name: Jumper Wire Kit (120 pcs M-M, M-F, F-F)
description: 120-piece jumper wire assortment with 40 each of Male-Male, Male-Female, and Female-Female wires. 20cm length, color-coded for easy identification. Must-have for breadboard prototyping.

name: Casio FX-991EX Scientific Calculator
description: Casio Classwiz FX-991EX with 552 functions, spreadsheet calculations, QR code output, and high-resolution LCD. The definitive calculator for engineering and science students.

name: Engineering Drawing Instrument Kit
description: Professional engineering drawing kit with compass, dividers, set squares (30°/60° and 45°), protractor, French curves, mini drafter, and carrying case. Essential for first-year engineering.

name: A4 Ruled Notebook Pack (6 pcs, 200 pages each)
description: Pack of 6 premium A4 ruled notebooks, 200 pages each. 70 GSM acid-free paper, hard-bound cover. Perfect for lecture notes, assignments, and exam preparation.

name: Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
description: Over-ear wireless headphones with Active Noise Cancellation, 40-hour battery life, Hi-Res Audio, foldable design, and built-in mic. Perfect for studying in noisy libraries and hostels.

name: USB-C Hub 7-in-1 (HDMI, USB 3.0, SD Card)
description: 7-in-1 USB-C hub with 4K HDMI output, 3x USB 3.0, SD/TF card reader, and 100W PD charging. Compact aluminum body. Essential for connecting your laptop to lab projectors and peripherals.

name: 10000mAh Power Bank (22.5W Fast Charge)
description: Compact 10000mAh power bank with 22.5W fast charging, dual USB-A + USB-C ports, LED indicator. Slim enough to carry in your pocket. Never run out of battery during lectures again.

name: Let Us C by Yashavant Kanetkar (17th Ed.)
description: The definitive C programming textbook for Indian engineering students. Covers fundamentals, pointers, structures, file handling, and data structures. Includes practice problems and solutions.

name: Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS) — 4th Edition
description: The comprehensive, authoritative guide to algorithms by Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest, and Stein. Covers sorting, graph algorithms, dynamic programming, NP-completeness and more. The CS bible.

name: Campus Backpack 35L (Laptop Compartment)
description: Spacious 35L backpack with padded 15.6-inch laptop compartment, USB charging port, water-resistant fabric, and ergonomic straps. Multiple organizer pockets for books, chargers, and bottles.

name: Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle (1L)
description: Double-wall vacuum insulated stainless steel bottle. Keeps drinks cold for 24 hours, hot for 12 hours. Leak-proof lid, BPA-free, 1-litre capacity. Carry it to labs, lectures, and the gym.

name: USB LED Desk Lamp (3 Color Modes, Dimmable)
description: Foldable USB-powered LED desk lamp with 3 color temperatures (warm/neutral/cool), 5 brightness levels, and touch controls. Eye-caring flicker-free light for late-night study sessions.
